governance_center: retrieve the current live OpenRouter reasoning/popularity candidate inventory
preserve candidate metadata and transport integrity without fixed Top-N truncation
bind the candidate plan to the current task SHA-256
declare no-tools as the only hard model-execution boundary
transport the complete candidate pool to the Expert Center
expert_center: validate governance plan schema, task hash, candidate transport and plan hash
derive the current task work graph, decisions, parameter designs and parameter values
dynamically determine team size, role topology, recovery breadth and request knobs
use OR-Tools CP-SAT or the same current-task deterministic fallback to assign models
prefer cross-company AI heterogeneity as a soft secondary objective after task fit and current-run reliability
execute selected models with unrestricted OpenRouter provider routing
recompute recovery order from current-run failures and promote standby models when useful
publish model, company, provider, parameter, token, cost, quality and audit evidence
hard_model_boundary: no tools, browsing, search, MCP, functions, code execution, file search, connectors or external APIs
not_hard_gates: fixed expert count or role topology
company uniqueness or fixed company count
fixed call, token or cost ceilings

use_when: the task requires multidisciplinary judgment rather than only deterministic calculation
evidence, assumptions, trade-offs, strategy, policy, business, risk, or red-team analysis must be synthesized
the user explicitly requests the GitHub expert team
API or compute results require independent interpretation and adjudication
do_not_use_when: a fixed API connector can directly return the requested public data
a deterministic compute operation can fully answer the question
the user requests an immediate factual lookup without expert synthesis
the ticket would contain secrets, private personal data, or unverified artifact identifiers without the underlying body

quality_policy.primary_rule: current-task observable delivery contract and evidence integrity
quality_policy.semantic_completeness_rule: explicit task obligations must contain substantive final-delivery content; headings alone are insufficient
quality_policy.arithmetic_rule: explicit observable arithmetic and linear threshold equations must be internally consistent
quality_policy.derived_quantity_rule: quantities provably derived from authoritative task inputs are allowed and retained; unsupported invented quantities fail closed
quality_policy.company_rule: prefer different companies as a soft secondary objective; duplicate companies do not invalidate execution
quality_policy.provider_rule: OpenRouter provider routing is unrestricted and provider choice is separate from Expert model assignment
quality_policy.failure_rule: nonretryable current-run model failures are remembered only within the current task; truncation first repairs request allowance before cross-model recovery

outputs: task-dynamic expert analyses and final synthesis
actual model/company/provider call ledger with tokens, cost and errors
ParameterDesign to ParameterSpec to ResolvedValue to RuntimeBinding evidence
company heterogeneity and recovery sequence audit
task-explicit semantic completeness and evidence integrity audit
governance model-plan digest and execution diagnosis
report SHA-256 and public comment manifest
artifact manifest and authoritative PASS, DEGRADED or FAIL status
completion_rule: Only an authoritative Expert terminal state with verified final delivery evidence is normal completion. queued, in_progress, accepted, GitHub workflow success, or artifact metadata alone are not business completion.
restrictions: GPTs must not choose a concrete model ID or provider
governance must not preselect the Expert team from its candidate inventory
experts cannot browse, call tools, plugins, APIs or download artifacts
recovery must remain finite and current-run-only; no unbounded model loops
no secret or private data in public issues
no self-answer by Web GPT before the GitHub report when delegation is explicit

upstream_guidance.api_first: Use the evidence/data center first when current structured public data is required.
upstream_guidance.compute_first: Use the compute center first when quantitative simulation or deterministic analysis is required.
upstream_guidance.evidence_transfer: GPTs must retrieve and verify complete upstream bodies and SHA values before creating the expert ticket.
